parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const rows=r.rows||r.input?.rows||[];const cfg=r.config||r.input?.config||{};if(!Array.isArray(rows)) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C5-A',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'ROWS_NOT_ARRAY',message:'rows must be an array.'},next_action:'provide_rows'}}];const limit=Math.max(1,Math.min(500,Number(cfg.limit||100)));const columns=Array.isArray(cfg.columns)&&cfg.columns.length?cfg.columns:Array.from(new Set(rows.flatMap(x=>Object.keys(x||{}))));const view=rows.slice(0,limit).map(row=>Object.fromEntries(columns.map(c=>[c,row?.[c]??null])));return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C5-A',component_version:'v1',dashboard:{columns,rows:view,total_rows:rows.length,shown_rows:view.length,truncated:rows.length>view.length},next_action:'render_or_return_dashboard',error:null}}];
